# Carolux Insulation LLC

> Owner-operated residential insulation contractor serving Charlotte, Gastonia, and the surrounding North Carolina Piedmont. Blown-in attic insulation, fiberglass batt, crawl space vapor barriers, and air sealing.

Carolux is run by its two owners, who are on site for every job: Tony Kermis, a former North Carolina home inspector, and Juan Gonzalez, who runs scheduling and customer care. Air sealing is included on every full insulation install at no extra charge. The company is fully insured and backs its work with a 2-year workmanship guarantee. Free, same-day written estimates.

## Services

- **Blown-In Attic Insulation** — Fiberglass or cellulose blown into the attic to the R-49 level the U.S. Department of Energy recommends for North Carolina. On every full install, air leaks are sealed first, at no extra charge.
- **Crawl Space & Vapor Barrier** — A heavy-duty ground vapor barrier laid across the crawl space floor to block moisture rising from the soil, plus fiberglass batt fitted between the floor joists to hold conditioned air. Includes a full inspection and drainage assessment.
- **Fiberglass Batt Insulation** — Hand-fitted fiberglass batt set between crawl space floor joists to steady the floors above, soften sound between levels, and keep conditioned air where it belongs.

## Service Area

Charlotte, Huntersville, Pineville, Matthews, Mint Hill, Concord, Harrisburg, Belmont, Cramerton, Gastonia, Lowell, Mount Holly, and Stanley, NC — plus the surrounding Piedmont. Carolux is a service-area business that travels to the customer; there is no public storefront.

## Service Pages

Dedicated pages for each service, with process, cost factors, and FAQs:

- [Attic Insulation](https://caroluxinsulation.com/services/attic-insulation): blown-in fiberglass or cellulose to the DOE-recommended R-49 for North Carolina, with air sealing included on every full install
- [Crawl Space Insulation & Vapor Barrier](https://caroluxinsulation.com/services/crawl-space-insulation): ground vapor barrier plus fiberglass batt between the floor joists, with a moisture and drainage inspection (Carolux does not do crawl space encapsulation)
- [Attic Air Sealing](https://caroluxinsulation.com/services/air-sealing): sealing air bypasses around recessed lights, the attic hatch, top plates, and penetrations before insulation goes in

## Booking

Free in-home estimates can be booked directly at https://cal.com/carolux-xzktck/free-in-home-estimate, or by calling (704) 228-2729. The estimate is an in-person visit; the written price is delivered the same day.
